event: Nala tells Links she won't open with books heaped all over; they open when these shelves are clean.

memory.fact: Nala will not open the Library's doors to patrons until the hall's shelves are clean.

event: She asks him to say if she lays hands on another book that would speed things.
Links: "Your Library now. Your call. I'll shout."

memory.fact: Links told Nala the Library is hers now, and when to open it is her call.

event: She reaches for Shelf Sight, and it opens bright and wide, every right shelf blazing clear.
For an hour she moves fast, heap to shelf and back, the stacks by the columns shrinking.

memory.fact: Through an afternoon of Shelf Sight, Nala shrank the stacks of books by the hall's columns.

event: When the sight fades she reaches again, and it sputters out; a hot sting stabs behind her eyes.

changes.note: Shelf Sight reached for again and failed; the mana is spent anyway
Backlash of the failed Shelf Sight: 1 health

memory.fact: Reaching again for Shelf Sight at once, Nala's sight sputtered out and stung behind her eyes.

event: She tries once more; it takes, but a pounding headache rides along with it for the hour.

changes.note: Shelf Sight opened at a cost, a headache: 1 mana

event: She works through it, slower, squinting, until it fades.
The fourth time, the sight opens clean and bright again, and her pace picks back up.

changes.note: Shelf Sight opened a fourth time: 1 mana

event: Partway through, a window opens: Synchronization Requested. Proceed to the core.

memory.fact: A window read: Synchronization Requested. Proceed to the core.

event: Overhead, the hall's gold light begins to sink toward evening amber.

event: Links: "Full. First time in centuries. Anything more you shelve pours out along the ley lines."
